name: The Sky is Burning

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 26 Survival check (trained) to extinguish fires swiftly or DC 23 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the haunt; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates and then resets after 1 round in which no living creatures are within the schoolhouse.
routine: (4 actions) Ghostly figures flying in the skies above hurl bits of burning debris down into the three rooms of the schoolhouse below. The haunt uses its first three actions to target a random creature within the schoolhouse with a burning debris ranged Strike. A creature can't be targeted more than once per round—if there aren't enough targets for all 3 Strikes, the leftover Strike actions are wasted. On its fourth action, the haunt causes the fires in the building itself to flare up—all creatures inside the building take 2d8 fire damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). These flare-ups are the most extreme in area A4a; creatures in areas A4b or A4c gain a +2 circumstance bonus on this Reflex save.

items.name: The Sky Breathes Smoke
items.text:
Trigger A living creature ends their turn inside the schoolroom

---
Effect Harrowing shrieks and frightening howls echo from the skies above as smoke plumes down into the rooms below. All creatures in the schoolhouse (areas A4a–A4c) must attempt a DC 21 Fortitude save save to avoid becoming Sickened 1 from the smoke (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: Fires suddenly spring up along the rafters of the exposed roof as strange, monstrous shapes can be glimpsed in the sky above, which is suddenly filled with smoke.
